## Pull request overview This PR adds `defaultProps` to component registrations to prevent components from collapsing when dragged into the designer. Components now appear with meaningful initial dimensions, content, and configurations. **Changes:** - Added `defaultProps` with initial dimensions, labels, placeholders, and sample content to 40+ component registrations - Added `defaultChildren` to container components that require nested elements - Added comprehensive test coverage for default props validation ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 42 out of 42 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.
